original.description: Studio portrait of Generaloberst Alfred Graf von Schlieffen in full dress uniform with Pour le Mérite, Order of the Black Eagle star and the Iron Cross; black-and-white photograph, 1906 — the year he retired as Chief of the General Staff (he was made Generalfeldmarschall in 1911).
original.licence: public domain — published before 1 January 1931 (Commons: PD in the United States; note the rule-of-the-shorter-term caveat outside the US)

colorization.author: Dave Tashner / Sandtable
colorization.method: AI-assisted colorization from the public-domain black-and-white original, 2026
colorization.licence: Sandtable project licence (same as the rest of the content); the underlying photograph is public domain
colorization.status: ok — label as 'colorized (AI-assisted)'; colour is interpretive except where documented (dark-blue Prussian tunic, gold epaulettes, black-and-silver Pour le Mérite ribbon)

caption: Alfred Graf von Schlieffen (1833–1913), Chief of the German General Staff 1891–1906, author of the December 1905 memorandum. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph.
credit: Original photograph: public domain (archive to confirm). Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026.
notes: Provided by Dave on 2026-08-22 for the Phase 1 prologue and the Person card. Hero image candidate for the prologue beat. Also wanted by a 1905 memorandum pack and a "road to 1914" learning thread when those are written.
